SRC-046:R001.text: Git inventory = tracked_existing UNION untracked_nonignored; tracked project truth overrides ordinary noise exclusions; hard-safety conflicts fail closed

SRC-046:R002.text: Tracked deletions are explicit (tracked_deleted); no per-file Git subprocesses; no recursive traversal of ignored recovery/cache trees

SRC-046:R003.text: Source inventory is frozen before writing; source disappearance/read failure fails closed; source mutation earns at most one complete retry
